column1: # WhiteMagic/MandalaOS custody manifest — machine-readable copy registry
# Fields (tab-separated): copy_id  key_id  media_label  media_uuid  path  sha256  status
# copy_id = <key letter><copy number>. status: active = must verify; planned = not yet created.
# No secret material. Verified by verify_custody.sh (read-only, UUID-anchored).
# Known cards: FA99-F6E6 (119.1 GB) and FEEC-FCE2 (59.5 GB); the owner holds no third card.
# Copies on an unmounted/wrong card report WRONG-MEDIA (inconclusive) and are re-verified on return.
